title: cheiloclinium krukovii
intro: Cheiloclinium krukovii, commonly known as "Climbing Corymbia" or "Grape Corymbia", is a plant species within the Apocynaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
